standardInstructions: In this quiz, you will see letter strings on the computer screen.
Your job is to decide if each string is a real Arabic word or not.
Respond as quickly and accurately as possible.
If the string is a real Arabic word, press the RIGHT ARROW key (→).
If the string is NOT a real Arabic word, press the LEFT ARROW key (←).
smallDeviceInstructions: In this quiz, you will see letter strings on the screen.
Your job is to decide if each string is a real Arabic word or not.
Respond as quickly and accurately as possible.
If the string is a real Arabic word, click the 'YES' button.
If the string is NOT a real Arabic word, click the 'NO' button.
